description: Task 008 parity study, stage 3. Traces v1's OWN configuration expansion rather than stage 2's output, so stage 3 is measured on the inputs v1 had and an upstream typing error is not scored twice. The only stage with no measured cost basis before this run: one tool-loop session per configuration, up to 15 turns. --limit 5 is the cost brake. rm and tee are on the destructive list and need Lima.
